baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three lexical anchors are the spring noun at word 1, drinking at word 2, and the passive brought-near plural at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A flowing source, literal drinking, and privileged nearness form an access mechanism: the group is not merely handed a finished cup but admitted to the source itself.

activation_trace.role: The flowing water-source supplies the place and continuous origin of the drink.
Literal imbibing turns access to the source into bodily participation.
Favored close access explains why this plural group reaches the source directly.

changed_reading.before: The brought-near drink from a spring.
changed_reading.after: The brought-near are admitted to drink at the flowing source, so nearness is enacted as direct access rather than only named as rank.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural subject and the water-share and co-drinker branches of the finite verb remain attached to يشرب and المقربون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Drinking can organize a social distribution: a favored cohort shares a watering relation in which each has an allotted portion rather than consuming as isolated individuals.

activation_trace.role: The spring supplies a common renewable source around which distribution can occur.
The allotted water-share makes drinking a portioned entitlement.
The co-drinker group makes the plural subject a drinking fellowship rather than a set of detached consumers.
Privileged nearness marks the cohort whose share and access are secured.

changed_reading.before: Several honored individuals happen to drink the same beverage.
changed_reading.after: A recognized cohort takes its secured water-share together at one source; the drink establishes a social relation as well as satisfying thirst.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The instrumental possibility of بها joins the spring at word 1 to the permeation branch of يشرب and abstract proximity in المقربون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of treating liquid as only passing through the drinker, the source can be the medium that imbues the interior; nearness then describes reduced separation produced or expressed through that permeation.

activation_trace.role: The eye of watchful care lets the source carry an atmosphere of sustaining attention.
Permeation and being imbued move drinking from surface consumption into interior formation.
Nearness supplies the resulting collapse of distance between source and drinker.

changed_reading.before: They consume liquid located at a spring.
changed_reading.after: They are imbued through the source, with drinking functioning as a medium of nearness and sustaining care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive form المقربون can retain its brought-toward force while the root's water-seeking branch converges with the spring and literal drinking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root constellation describes a trajectory: people are conducted toward a watering place, arrive at its flowing source, and drink. This keeps bestowed nearness but makes it kinetic rather than static.

activation_trace.role: The spring is the destination toward which the movement is organized.
Literal drinking completes the movement at the watering source.
The water-seeker moving toward a watering place supplies a dynamic substrate for being brought near.
Devotional approach keeps the trajectory relational rather than merely spatial.

changed_reading.before: The brought-near is a fixed honorific for people already at the spring.
changed_reading.after: The plural can also preserve the completed motion of people conducted waterward until approach becomes arrival and drinking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry of taking full measure while giving loss converts the focus water-share into a repaired transaction: the later cohort receives an undiminished allotment at the source.

activation_trace.role: The water-share anchors the changed reading in the focus act of drinking.
Favored access identifies the recipients whose portion is no longer vulnerable to another party's manipulation.
Measured food supplies the concrete transaction pattern later transferred to the allotted drink.
Completion without deficiency supplies the positive standard for the later share.
The balance of justice turns quantity into a moral relation between giver and receiver.
Shorting measure supplies the failed distribution that the spring-allotment reverses.

structural_cues: The branchless ط ف ف occurrence at 83:1 structurally announces minute shortfall without supplying a branch citation.
83:2-3 reverses grammatical direction: full receipt for self, induced loss when giving to others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exact measure, completion without نقص, just balance, and short measure surround a focus verb with a water-share branch. Reader arrow: the later share repairs the opening asymmetry. Alternative: the commercial scene may establish judgment generally without specifying the drink's distribution.

changed_reading.before: The spring is an abundant luxury available to an honored group.
changed_reading.after: The drink is also the group's fully delivered allotment, a measured share from which nothing is withheld or shaved away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two modes of inward accumulation become legible: repeated acquisition leaves an enclosing deposit on hearts, while the source-mixture permeates the brought-near. The focus drink is therefore a counter-process of interior formation.

activation_trace.role: The flowing source supplies the positive material that can enter rather than enclose the person.
Being imbued, including mixture into the heart, anchors the inward counter-process in the focus verb.
Nearness names the diminished separation produced by receptive permeation.
An inescapable overlying condition supplies the negative model of interior accretion.
The heart identifies the interior site on which the two material processes diverge.
Repeated acquisition supplies the feedstock for the enclosing deposit.
Mixing one thing into another confirms that the blessed liquid is compositionally penetrative rather than inert.

structural_cues: 83:14 assigns the obstruction to what subjects repeatedly acquired, while 83:27-28 places mixture immediately before drinking.
The contrast is directional: coating closes from outside; drinking admits and distributes within.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hearts are overlaid by acquisitions, the later drink is mixed, and شرب can denote permeation into the heart. Reader arrow: these are opposed interior-forming processes. Alternative: the heart scene and beverage scene may remain moral and sensory contrasts without a shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The drink rewards people whose moral state was formed elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: The drink itself participates in formation: it permeates the brought-near in inverse relation to the earned layer that seals other hearts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same brought-near group witnesses the marked register, then inhabits a scene of looking, and finally drinks at the eye/source. Direct seeing and the understanding branch of drinking make the beverage a mode of participatory certainty without canceling literal liquid.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face seeing lets the spring also function as manifest encounter.
Absorbing as understanding turns drinking into epistemic participation while retaining the literal act.
Privileged access joins proximity to both witnessing and drinking.
Ordered written signs provide the object whose truth can be read and witnessed.
The inscribed mark makes the record determinate rather than a vague report.
Presence with direct observation gives the brought-near firsthand epistemic access.
The repeated favored group links the witnesses at the record to the drinkers at the source.
Directed sight extends firsthand apprehension from the register into the scene of bliss.

structural_cues: المقربون is repeated at 83:21 and 83:28, first as witnesses and then as drinkers.
Looking at 83:23 follows the witnessing identity before the sequence turns to drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the identical group witnesses a marked record, looks, and drinks; عين includes direct encounter and شرب includes understanding. Reader arrow: sensory ingestion and epistemic apprehension reinforce one another. Alternative: witnessing and drinking may be separate privileges linked only by their subject.

changed_reading.before: The group knows the record and separately enjoys a beverage.
changed_reading.after: Their drinking also images firsthand apprehension: they take in as directly as they witness, so nearness grants both access and certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Serving, selected purity, secure sealing, mixture, and elevation form a supply chain. The focus spring can identify the upstream reserve from which the finished drink is composed, while the brought-near receive source-level access.

activation_trace.role: The flowing spring supplies the upstream origin of the mixed drink.
Literal drinking is the terminal act in the supply chain.
Privileged access distinguishes those who drink at or by the reserve itself.
Giving drink supplies the downstream service stage before source access is disclosed.
A pure selected wine supplies the refined liquid being served.
A secure preventing seal makes the served liquid a protected reserve rather than an open commodity.
Mixture explicitly connects the served liquid to another contributing source.
Elevation locates that contribution conceptually upstream and above the served vessel.

structural_cues: 83:27 says that its mixture is from Tasnim and 83:28 immediately opens with an indefinite accusative spring.
The preposition in بها permits the spring to be read as source-associated or instrumental, while not forcing a single syntactic resolution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a sealed selected drink is served, mixed from an elevated term, then a spring is named. Reader arrow: the spring is the upstream reserve and direct access is the privilege. Alternative: 83:28 may begin a separate specification or fresh predication rather than map a production chain.

changed_reading.before: The spring is another beverage after the sealed mixed drink.
changed_reading.after: The spring is plausibly the elevated source-reserve entering that drink, and the brought-near drink with direct access to its origin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Competition for what is precious supplies directed desire; the focus root then offers both devotional approach and movement toward water. Being brought near can preserve gift while also naming the endpoint of an oriented approach.

activation_trace.role: The spring gives directed desire a concrete destination.
Drinking realizes the sought good as participation rather than distant possession.
Devotional approach makes nearness the relational endpoint of striving.
The water-seeker moving toward a watering place gives that approach a hydrological trajectory.
Souls competing for a precious thing supply appetite organized toward the drink-source.

structural_cues: The imperative to compete at 83:26 precedes the mixture and spring sequence at 83:27-28.
The passive morphology of المقربون still presents arrival as something effected upon the group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: competition concerns a precious object, while قرب offers devotional approach and water-seeking. Reader arrow: competition is a vector whose endpoint is brought-near access. Alternative: the competition may concern reward generally and need not cause or describe the group's nearness.

changed_reading.before: The brought-near are a static class who drink after their status is settled.
changed_reading.after: Their title can also hold the completed trajectory of rightly directed desire: sought, brought toward the source, and admitted to drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene distinguishes looking from authorized guardianship. Against uncommissioned scrutiny, the focus eye branch can activate watchful care; drinking by the spring then becomes sustenance under rightful attention rather than exposure to hostile surveillance.

activation_trace.role: The watchful eye of care converts the source into a figure of protective attention.
Permeation makes that care sustaining and interior rather than merely observational.
Favored access identifies those held within the protective relation.
Directed sight supplies the morally reversible act whose authority depends on who looks and from where.
Visual and inward seeing supplies the mockers' act of inspection and judgment.
Sending and commissioning supplies the authorization explicitly denied to the hostile observers.
Guarding and watchful preservation define the role the observers were not assigned.

structural_cues: 83:32 moves from seeing to a verdict, and 83:33 immediately denies that those viewers were sent as guardians.
83:35 repeats looking after the social reversal, separating sight itself from its earlier misuse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hostile viewers issue judgment without a guarding commission, while عين can denote watchful care. Reader arrow: the focus source embodies rightful sustaining attention in contrast to unauthorized scrutiny. Alternative: عين here may remain only a spring and 83:33 may rebuke judgment without activating care in 83:28.

changed_reading.before: The spring is an object enjoyed while the group is seen from outside.
changed_reading.after: The eye-spring can also mark a protected field of attention: the brought-near drink under care, not under the mockers' self-appointed surveillance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired laughter and repeated looking reverse subject and object across the ending. The focus co-drinker branch makes the brought-near a public fellowship whose shared access embodies returned recognition, not merely private pleasure.

activation_trace.role: Manifest encounter makes the cohort's vindication publicly apprehensible rather than hidden.
Drinkers and watering companions anchor the social fellowship in the focus verb.
Favored access reverses the status assigned by the earlier hostile public.
Directed sight repeats the earlier viewing relation from the reversed position.
Wrongdoing and offense identify the agents who first weaponize public laughter.
Settled trust identifies the formerly mocked group whose relation is later reversed.
Displayed laughter supplies the first public affect, here directed against believers.
The same visible affect returns with subject and object exchanged.
Recompense returning to its agent closes the reversal as an enacted return rather than coincidence.

structural_cues: 83:29 and 83:34 repeat laughter while exchanging the believing and rejecting groups' positions.
83:23 and 83:35 exactly repeat the couch-and-looking scene, making public viewpoint part of the reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: laughter, viewpoint, group labels, and returning recompense reverse across the closing scene; شرب can name co-drinkers. Reader arrow: shared source-access constitutes the vindicated group as a public fellowship. Alternative: their drinking may be private reward merely adjacent to, not constitutive of, the social reversal.

changed_reading.before: Each brought-near person privately enjoys a drink before the narrative turns to mockery.
changed_reading.after: Shared drinking establishes a visible counter-public whose granted nearness reverses the earlier community of ridicule and its false verdict.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates commercial عين and consumable wealth inside an apparent spring scene. It remains valid as a cross-domain model because every move is anchored in focus branches and the context supplies debt, adjudicative record, and returned recompense. Render it only as a financial-material resonance, not as a replacement lexical translation of عينا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عين at word 1 can denote present cash as opposed to debt, while يشرب at word 2 can denote wealth consumed in feeding and watering and المقربون marks privileged receipt.

activation_trace.role: Present tangible money opposed to deferred debt makes the spring image available as realized settlement.
Wealth consumed through feeding and watering turns settlement into usable, embodied benefit.
Privileged access identifies the recipients to whom the realized benefit is delivered.
A written establishment carrying judgment or decree supplies the binding account.
Accounting and recompense supply the settlement frame.
Financial debt supplies the deferred obligation against which present عين contrasts.
The consequence returning to its worker supplies final payment back to the account-holder.

changed_reading.before: The spring is solely a natural source of water or drink.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the liquid source is also the present, consumable realization of a recorded and formerly deferred due.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it coordinates object senses from three focus roots into a hydraulic apparatus. It remains anchored because عين supplies a waterskin opening, شرب supplies conditioning a skin with water, قرب supplies the waterskin itself, and the adjacent context supplies sealing, holding, and mixing. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy or word-field echo, never the sentence's direct lexical parse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: All three content roots can participate in a waterskin mechanism: an eye-like opening, water-conditioned skin, and a water container.

activation_trace.role: The eye-like hole or thin leaking place supplies the aperture of the imagined vessel system.
Seasoning a new waterskin with water to improve it and close its openings supplies vessel preparation.
The waterskin branch supplies the containing body of the apparatus.
Secure sealing supplies controlled closure of the container.
A place that holds water supplies retention within the material system.
Mixing supplies the operation performed on what the sealed vessel contains.

changed_reading.before: The ayah names drinkers beside a spring.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, it also assembles source-opening, prepared skin, sealed containment, mixture, and release into one hydraulic chain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the quenching image comes from the packet's non-dominant mapped root for رأوهم, not from the ordinary seeing target. It remains useful because the packet explicitly preserves both mapped inventories and the focus itself joins eye, drinking, and favored access. Render it as a split-root activation that exposes a sight/thirst reversal, never as a claim that رأوهم lexically means they were quenched here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence itself moves from عين as eye/source through literal drinking to privileged nearness, allowing visual and hydric satisfaction to coexist.

activation_trace.role: The seeing eye anchors the visual pole directly in the focus noun.
Literal drinking anchors bodily quenching in the focus action.
Favored access joins true encounter to satisfaction at the source.
Ordinary eye and inward seeing supply the hostile act of viewing and judging.
The preserved non-dominant mapping supplies quenching as the unexpected hydric counterpart to sight.
Bringing and carrying water gives the split-root activation a movement toward provision rather than a loose sound association.

changed_reading.before: The mockers see while the brought-near later drink, two unrelated sensory acts.
changed_reading.after: The split inventory lets the reversal pair defective seeing with denied satiety, while the brought-near receive both direct encounter and quenching at the eye-source.

strongest_changes: The opening measure economy changes the drink into an undiminished allotted share, not abundance without distribution.
The repeated brought-near witnesses join eye and understanding branches so drinking becomes firsthand apprehension as well as ingestion.
Serving, sealing, mixing, and elevation recast the spring as an upstream protected reserve to which the group has direct access.
The heart-overlay contrast activates drinking as inward permeation and counter-accretion.
The closing reversal activates the drinkers as a publicly vindicated fellowship rather than isolated beneficiaries.
summary.what_was_special: The compact focus sequence supports several mechanisms at once: source access, exact share, permeation, witnessed understanding, waterward approach, and social incorporation. The instrumental breadth of بها and the collision of eye/source, drink/understand, and nearness/water-seeking branches preserve unusually productive ambiguity; the packet's non-dominant رأى-to-روي mapping adds a contained sight/quenching outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic relation of عينا to Tasnim and the exact force of بها can support source, accompaniment, instrument, or a fresh predication without being settled here.
The water-seeking and devotional branches of قرب may illuminate process while the passive morphology still foregrounds bestowed status.
The present-settlement and hydraulic-container readings are traceable cross-domain analogies, not secure lexical parses of this construction.
The arrow from commanded competition to being brought near is abductive; the packet does not state that the striving causes the status.
